items.briefing:
ASIC has issued a warning that scammers are using AI to create convincing deepfake investment scam networks targeting Australians — fake videos, voices, and profiles designed to trick people into handing over money. Separately, ABC News reports home loan fraud has been uncovered across 10 major Australian banks, a reminder that financial crime can affect everyday customers. A China-linked hacker has also demonstrated AI-assisted attack capabilities in the Asia-Pacific region, which may have implications for Australian organisations.

If you receive an unsolicited investment opportunity online — especially involving a video endorsement — treat it with extreme scepticism and verify through official channels before engaging.

featured.title: PCI council marks 20 years with AI focus in Kuala Lumpur
featured.summary: Banks and merchants face fresh fraud risks as the council's Kuala Lumpur meeting weighs how AI is changing payment security.
